title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Rosemont Theatre, Rosemont | 2003
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Rosemont Theatre in Rosemont, Illinois, USA, on 12 August 2003.

It was the 16th show by the eighth All-Starr Band. Their tour of North America lasted for 35 dates between July and September 2003.

Starr had previously performed at the Rosemont Theatre on 22 August 2001. He returned there on 17 June 2006.

The eighth All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion
  • Colin Hay: vocals, guitar
  • Paul Carrack: vocals, guitar, keyboards
  • John Waite: vocals, bass guitar, guitar
  • Mark Rivera: vocals, saxophone, percussion, guitar, bass, harmonica, flute
  • Sheila E: vocals, drums, percussion
